title: Minimum Bottleneck Path Queries
description: For every query `[u,v]`, find a path from `u` to `v` that minimizes the largest edge weight on the path. Return that minimum largest-edge weight, or -1 if no path exists. The answer for `u == v` is 0.
hints: Sort candidate edges by weight and use a disjoint-set structure to track connected components.
Respect the stated tie-breaking rule and handle disconnected graphs if allowed.
